items.title: John Budd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [transcript only]
items.q: The people I was with were so great, the team. And those young men, the two guys, Eddie Jason was one

ctx.x: Gee. Did it wear on you emotionally?

No I don’t think so. I was really excited. I was delighted. I thought I liked it. The people I was with were so great, the team. And those young men, the two guys, Eddie Jason was one, I haven’t seen him. He’s dead since then. But he came from Providence, Rhode Island. And he probably was a mechanic or salesman or something, and probably about 25 years old. Eddie Jason was his name. And he was just a marvelous little guy. The other fellow was Tony — I’ve forgotten it now, but I got in touch with him. Jason died…
Same here. You can tell when you’re in those kind of gatherings you know...
